SELECT
    eh.envhealthregistry AS environmental_registry,
    de.affectedarea AS affected_area,
    de.haztype AS hazard_type,
    eh.envimpactrate AS environmental_impact_rate,
    CASE 
        WHEN eh.envimpactrate = 'Low' THEN 'Category 1'
        WHEN eh.envimpactrate = 'Medium' THEN 'Category 2'

FROM 
    environmentandhealth eh
JOIN 
    disasterevents de ON eh.envdistref = de.distregistry
ORDER BY 
    environmental_registry;

    de.affectedarea AS affected_area,

    eh.envimpactrate AS environmental_impact_rate,
    CASE 
        WHEN eh.envimpactrate = 'Low' THEN 'Category 1'
        WHEN eh.envimpactrate = 'Medium' THEN 'Category 2'
        WHEN eh.envimpactrate = 'High' THEN 'Category 3'
    END AS category
FROM 
    environmentandhealth eh

    disasterevents de ON eh.envdistref = de.distregistry
ORDER BY 
    environmental_registry;
